recipes.name: Cevapi Sausages
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53055. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Place the ground meat in a bowl. Chop the onion very finely and grate the garlic cloves. Add to the bowl. Add the chopped parsley, all sorts of paprika, baking soda, dried breadcrumbs, water, Vegeta, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mix well with the hand mixer fitted with the dough hooks. Cover the bowl with cling film/ plastic foil and leave to rest for 1 or 2 hours in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Take portions of the meat mixture, about 50-55 g/ 1.7-1.9 oz/ ¼ cup portions, and form the cevapi. The rolls should be about as thick as your thumb and about 7-10 cm/ 3-4 inches long. I had 18 sausages. The recipe can be easily doubled.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Grill the cevapcici on the hot grill pan or on the barbecue for about 12-14 minutes, turning them several times in between, or until brown and cooked through. I checked by cutting one in the middle and then grilling the following batches for the same period of time.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Serve hot as suggested above. The cevapcici can be reheated in the oven at 180 degrees Celsius/ 350 degrees Fahrenheit for about 10 minutes or until heated through. Check one, if it is not hot enough, give the sausages a few more minutes.

recipes.name: Croatian Bean Stew
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53058. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Add the chopped vegetables and sauté until tender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Take a pot, empty the beans together with the vegetables into it, put the sausages inside and cook for further 20 minutes on a low heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Or, put it in an oven and bake it at a temperature of 180ºC/350ºF for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: This dish is even better reheated the next day.

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 200°C fan / 220°C / 425°F / Gas mark 7

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: If you have not bought diced lamb, cut your lamb shoulder or leg into large chunks and place to one side.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Chunks of chopped lamb of a red chopping board

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Make oil marinade -

steps.title: Step 5

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: olive oil, gia sundried tomato puree and gia garlic puree and black pepper mixed together in a silver bowl to make Croatian peka

steps.title: Step 7

steps.title: Step 8

recipes.name: Traditional Croatian Goulash
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53057. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Clean the meat from the veins if there are some and cut it into smaller pieces, 3 × 3 cm. Marinate the meat in the mustard and spices and let it sit in the refrigerator for one hour

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat one tablespoon of pork fat or vegetable oil in a pot and fry the meat on all sides until it gets browned. Once the meat is cooked, transfer it to a plate and add another tablespoon of fat to the pot

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Cut the onions very fine, peel the carrots and shred it using a grater. Cook the onions and carrots over low heat for 15 minutes. You can salt the vegetables a little to make them soften faster

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Once the vegetables have browned and become slightly mushy, add the meat and bay leaves and garlic. Pour over with wine and simmer for 10-15 minutes to allow the alcohol to evaporate. Now is the right time to add 2/3 the amount of liquid

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Cover the pot and cook over low heat for an hour, stirring occasionally. After the first hour, pour over the rest of the water or stock and cook for another 30-45 minutes

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Allow the stew to cool slightly and serve it with a sprinkle of chopped parsley and few slices of fresh hot pepper if you like to spice it up a bit

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Slice ​​some fresh bread, season the salad and simply enjoying these wonderful flavors
